int* ready = nullptr;                      // per block: 1 once rows and panel are published on node\n    std::vector<double*> blkRows, blkP;        // per block: finished rows / transposed panel (node copy)\n    std::vector<size_t> blkStride;\n    std::vector<std::pair<size_t, MPI_Request>> recvs;  // pending inter-node receives (block order)\n    size_t recvHead = 0;\n    std::vector<MPI_Request> sends;\n    std::vector<double> S;                     // accumulator scratch\n};\n\n// S[r][t*8 .. t*8+7] += sum_{k in chunk} rows[r][k] * Pt[k][0..7]  (sequential in k per element)\ntemplate <size_t R>\nstatic inline void microKernel(const double* const* rows, const double* Pt, size_t klen, double* S) {\n    v4 acc0[R], acc1[R];\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n        acc0[r] = *(const v4u*)(S + r * NB);\n        acc1[r] = *(const v4u*)(S + r * NB + 4);\n    }\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < klen; ++k) {\n        const v4 p0 = *(const v4u*)(Pt + k * 8);\n        const v4 p1 = *(const v4u*)(Pt + k * 8 + 4);\n        for (size_t r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n            const double a = rows[r][k];\n            acc0[r] += noContract(a * p0);\n            acc1[r] += noContract(a * p1);\n        }\n    }\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n        *(v4u*)(S + r * NB) = acc0[r];\n        *(v4u*)(S + r * NB + 4) = acc1[r];\n    }\n}\n\ntemplate <size_t R>\nstatic inline void microKernelTiles(double* const* rowsBase, size_t k0, const double* P, size_t j0,\n                                    size_t ntiles, size_t klen, double* S) {\n    const double* rows[R];\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < R; ++r) rows[r] = rowsBase[r] + k0;\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < ntiles; ++t)\n        microKernel<R>(rows, P + t * j0 * 8 + k0 * 8, klen, S + t * 8);\n}\n\n// Build transposed panel P (tiles of 8 columns, k-major) from rows rowPtr(jj), columns < j0\ntemplate <typename RowFn>\nstatic void buildPanel(double* P, size_t j0, size_t nbb, RowFn rowPtr) {\n    const size_t ntiles = (nbb + 7) / 8;\n    for (size_t t = 0; t < ntiles; ++t) {\n        double* Pt = P + t * j0 * 8;\n        for (size_t c = 0; c < 8; ++c) {\n            const size_t jj = t * 8 + c;\n            if (jj < nbb) {\n                const double* src = rowPtr(jj);\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j0; ++k) Pt[k * 8 + c] = src[k];\n            } else {\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j0; ++k) Pt[k * 8 + c] = 0.0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nstatic void publish(Ctx& c, size_t b) {\n    MPI_Win_sync(c.dataWin);\n    MPI_Win_sync(c.flagWin);\n    std::atomic_ref<int>(c.ready[b]).store(1, std::memory_order_release);\n}\n\n// Drive inter-node communication: complete receives in block order and publish them\nstatic void progress(Ctx& c) {\n    while (c.recvHead < c.recvs.size()) {\n        int flag = 0;\n        MPI_Test(&c.recvs[c.recvHead].second, &flag, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        if (!flag) break;\n        const size_t b = c.recvs[c.recvHead].first;\n        const size_t j0 = b * NB, nbb = c.d.blockRows(b), j1 = j0 + nbb;\n        const double* rows = c.blkRows[b];\n        buildPanel(c.blkP[b], j0, nbb, [&](size_t jj) { return rows + jj * j1; });\n        publish(c, b);\n        ++c.recvHead;\n    }\n    if (!c.sends.empty()) {\n        int outcount = 0;\n        std::vector<int> idx(c.sends.size());\n        MPI_Testsome((int)c.sends.size(), c.sends.data(), &outcount, idx.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n        if (outcount > 0)\n            c.sends.erase(std::remove(c.sends.begin(), c.sends.end(), MPI_REQUEST_NULL), c.sends.end());\n    }\n}\n\nstatic void waitReady(Ctx& c, size_t b) {\n    while (std::atomic_ref<int>(c.ready[b]).load(std::memory_order_acquire) == 0) {\n        progress(c);\n        __builtin_ia32_pause();\n    }\n    MPI_Win_sync(c.dataWin);\n    MPI_Win_sync(c.flagWin);\n}\n\n// Accumulate S[r][jj] = sum_{k<j0} L[row r][k] * L[j0+jj][k] for local rows [lb, le).\n// P holds rows j0..j0+NB-1 of L, columns < j0, transposed in tiles of 8 columns.\nstatic void accumulatePanel(Ctx& c, size_t lb, size_t le, const double* P, size_t j0, size_t nbb) {\n    const size_t n = c.d.n;\n    const size_t cnt = le - lb;\n    double* S = c.S.data();\n    std::fill(S, S + cnt * NB, 0.0);\n    const size_t ntiles = (nbb + 7) / 8;\n    for (size_t k0 = 0; k0 < j0; k0 += KC) {\n        const size_t klen = std::min(KC, j0 - k0);\n        size_t r = 0;\n        for (; r + MR <= cnt; r += MR) {\n            double* rows[MR];\n            for (size_t q = 0; q < MR; ++q) rows[q] = c.myRows + (lb + r + q) * n;\n            microKernelTiles<MR>(rows, k0, P, j0, ntiles, klen, S + r * NB);\n        }\n        for (; r < cnt; ++r) {\n            double* rows[1] = {c.myRows + (lb + r) * n};\n            microKernelTiles<1>(rows, k0, P, j0, ntiles, klen, S + r * NB);\n        }\n        progress(c);\n    }\n}\n\n// Compute columns [j0, j0+nbb) of local rows [lb, le) (rows below the diagonal block b).\nstatic void computePanel(Ctx& c, size_t b, size_t lb, size_t le) {\n    if (lb >= le) return;\n    const size_t n = c.d.n;\n    const size_t j0 = b * NB, nbb = c.d.blockRows(b);\n    accumulatePanel(c, lb, le, c.blkP[b], j0, nbb);\n    const double* rowsB = c.blkRows[b];\n    const size_t stride = c.blkStride[b];\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < le - lb; ++r) {\n        double* Li = c.myRows + (lb + r) * n;\n        const double* Sr = &c.S[r * NB];\n        for (size_t jj = 0; jj < nbb; ++jj) {\n            const double* Lj = rowsB + jj * stride;\n            const double sum = dotContinue(Sr[jj], Li, Lj, j0, j0 + jj);\n            Li[j0 + jj] = (Li[j0 + jj] - sum) / Lj[j0 + jj];\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Factor the locally owned diagonal block b, publish it on the node and send it to other nodes.\nstatic void factorDiagonal(Ctx& c, size_t b) {\n    const size_t n = c.d.n;\n    const size_t j0 = b * NB, nbb = c.d.blockRows(b), j1 = j0 + nbb;\n    const size_t lb = c.d.localRowOfBlock(b);\n    double* rows = c.myRows + lb * n;\n    buildPanel(c.blkP[b], j0, nbb, [&](size_t jj) { return rows + jj * n; });\n    accumulatePanel(c, lb, lb + nbb, c.blkP[b], j0, nbb);\n    long long fail = -1;\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < nbb && fail < 0; ++r) {\n        double* Li = rows + r * n;\n        for (size_t jj = 0; jj <= r; ++jj) {\n            const size_t j = j0 + jj;\n            const double* Lj = rows + jj * n;\n            const double sum = dotContinue(c.S[r * NB + jj], Li, Lj, j0, j);\n            if (jj == r) {\n                const double val = Li[j] - sum;\n                if (val <= 0.0) {\n                    // Matrix is not positive definite\n                    fail = (long long)j;\n                    break;\n                }\n                Li[j] = sqrt(val);\n            } else {\n                Li[j] = (Li[j] - sum) / Lj[j];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    // Zero out upper triangular part of the finished rows\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < nbb; ++r) std::fill(rows + r * n + j0 + r + 1, rows + (r + 1) * n, 0.0);\n\n    c.status[b] = (double)fail;\n    publish(c, b);\n\n    // Send status + rows (columns < j1) to the designated receiver of every other node\n    if (c.nnodes > 1) {\n        std::vector<int> lens(nbb + 1);\n        std::vector<MPI_Aint> disp(nbb + 1);\n        lens[0] = 1;\n        MPI_Get_address(&c.status[b], &disp[0]);\n        for (size_t r = 0; r < nbb; ++r) {\n            lens[r + 1] = (int)j1;\n            MPI_Get_address(rows + r * n, &disp[r + 1]);\n        }\n        MPI_Datatype t;\n        MPI_Type_create_hindexed((int)(nbb + 1), lens.data(), disp.data(), MPI_DOUBLE, &t);\n        MPI_Type_commit(&t);\n        for (int m = 0; m < c.nnodes; ++m) {\n            if (m == c.myNode) continue;\n            const std::vector<int>& nr = c.nodeRanks[m];\n            const int dest = nr[b % nr.size()];\n            MPI_Request req;\n            MPI_Isend(MPI_BOTTOM, 1, t, dest, (int)(b % 32768), MPI_COMM_WORLD, &req);\n            c.sends.push_back(req);\n        }\n        MPI_Type_free(&t);\n    }\n}\n\n// Set up node communicator, shared window layout and pre-posted inter-node receives\nstatic void setupContext(Ctx& c) {\n    const Dist& d = c.d;\n    const size_t n = d.n, nb = d.nblocks;\n\n    MPI_Comm_split_type(MPI_COMM_WORLD, MPI_COMM_TYPE_SHARED, d.rank, MPI_INFO_NULL, &c.nodeComm);\n    MPI_Comm_rank(c.nodeComm, &c.nodeRank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(c.nodeComm, &c.nodeSize);\n\n    // Identify nodes by the global rank of their node-local rank 0\n    int leader = d.rank;\n    MPI_Bcast(&leader, 1, MPI_INT, 0, c.nodeComm);\n    std::vector<int> leaders(d.size);\n    MPI_Allgather(&leader, 1, MPI_INT, leaders.data(), 1, MPI_INT, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    std::vector<int> uniq(leaders);\n    std::sort(uniq.begin(), uniq.end());\n    uniq.erase(std::unique(uniq.begin(), uniq.end()), uniq.end());\n    c.nnodes = (int)uniq.size();\n    c.nodeOf.resize(d.size);\n    c.nodeRanks.assign(c.nnodes, {});\n    for (int g = 0; g < d.size; ++g) {\n        c.nodeOf[g] = (int)(std::lower_bound(uniq.begin(), uniq.end(), leaders[g]) - uniq.begin());\n        c.nodeRanks[c.nodeOf[g]].push_back(g);  // ascending global rank == node-local order\n    }\n    c.myNode = c.nodeOf[d.rank];\n    const std::vector<int>& local = c.nodeRanks[c.myNode];\n\n    // Layout of every node-local rank's segment: [own rows][provided panels / received rows]\n    std::vector<size_t> seg(c.nodeSize);\n    for (int q = 0; q < c.nodeSize; ++q) seg[q] = countLocalRows(n, local[q], d.size) * n;\n    std::vector<int> provQ(nb);\n    std::vector<size_t> offP(nb), offRows(nb);\n    for (size_t b = 0; b < nb; ++b) {\n        const size_t j0 = b * NB, nbb = d.blockRows(b), j1 = j0 + nbb;\n        const int own = d.owner(b);\n        if (c.nodeOf[own] == c.myNode) {\n            const int q = (int)(std::find(local.begin(), local.end(), own) - local.begin());\n            provQ[b] = q;\n            offRows[b] = d.localRowOfBlock(b) * n;\n            offP[b] = seg[q];\n            seg[q] += NB * j0;\n        } else {\n            const int q = (int)(b % (size_t)c.nodeSize);\n            provQ[b] = q;\n            offP[b] = seg[q];\n            seg[q] += NB * j0;\n            offRows[b] = seg[q];\n            seg[q] += nbb * j1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    MPI_Info info;\n    MPI_Info_create(&info);\n    MPI_Info_set(info, \"alloc_shared_noncontig\", \"true\");\n    double* base = nullptr;\n    MPI_Win_allocate_shared((MPI_Aint)(seg[c.nodeRank] * sizeof(double)), sizeof(double), info, c.nodeComm,\n                            &base, &c.dataWin);\n    MPI_Info_free(&info);\n    std::vector<double*> bases(c.nodeSize);\n    for (int q = 0; q < c.nodeSize; ++q) {\n        MPI_Aint sz;\n        int du;\n        MPI_Win_shared_query(c.dataWin, q, &sz, &du, &bases[q]);\n    }\n    c.myRows = bases[c.nodeRank];\n\n    // Flags: status (double) and ready (int) per block, owned by node-local rank 0\n    const size_t flagBytes = c.nodeRank == 0 ? nb * (sizeof(double) + sizeof(int)) : 0;\n    void* fbase = nullptr;\n    MPI_Win_allocate_shared((MPI_Aint)flagBytes, 1, MPI_INFO_NULL, c.nodeComm, &fbase, &c.flagWin);\n    {\n        MPI_Aint sz;\n        int du;\n        void* f0;\n        MPI_Win_shared_query(c.flagWin, 0, &sz, &du, &f0);\n        c.status = (double*)f0;\n        c.ready = (int*)((char*)f0 + nb * sizeof(double));\n    }\n    if (c.nodeRank == 0) {\n        for (size_t b = 0; b < nb; ++b) {\n            c.status[b] = -1.0;\n            c.ready[b] = 0;\n        }\n    }\n    MPI_Win_lock_all(MPI_MODE_NOCHECK, c.dataWin);\n    MPI_Win_lock_all(MPI_MODE_NOCHECK, c.flagWin);\n\n    c.blkRows.resize(nb);\n    c.blkP.resize(nb);\n    c.blkStride.resize(nb);\n    for (size_t b = 0; b < nb; ++b) {\n        const bool localOwner = c.nodeOf[d.owner(b)] == c.myNode;\n        c.blkRows[b] = bases[provQ[b]] + offRows[b];\n        c.blkP[b] = bases[provQ[b]] + offP[b];\n        c.blkStride[b] = localOwner ? n : b * NB + d.blockRows(b);\n    }\n\n    // Pre-post receives for remote blocks this rank publishes on its node\n    for (size_t b = 0; b < nb; ++b) {\n        const int own = d.owner(b);\n        if (c.nodeOf[own] == c.myNode || provQ[b] != c.nodeRank) continue;\n        const size_t nbb = d.blockRows(b), j1 = b * NB + nbb;\n        int lens[2] = {1, (int)(nbb * j1)};\n        MPI_Aint disp[2];\n        MPI_Get_address(&c.status[b], &disp[0]);\n        MPI_Get_address(c.blkRows[b], &disp[1]);\n        MPI_Datatype t;\n        MPI_Type_create_hindexed(2, lens, disp, MPI_DOUBLE, &t);\n        MPI_Type_commit(&t);\n        MPI_Request req;\n        MPI_Irecv(MPI_BOTTOM, 1, t, own, (int)(b % 32768), MPI_COMM_WORLD, &req);\n        MPI_Type_free(&t);\n        c.recvs.emplace_back(b, req);\n    }\n\n    c.S.assign(std::max<size_t>(d.lrows, 1) * NB, 0.0);\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n}\n\nstatic void freeContext(Ctx& c) {\n    for (auto& r : c.recvs) {\n        if (r.second != MPI_REQUEST_NULL) {\n            MPI_Cancel(&r.second);\n            MPI_Wait(&r.second, MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        }\n    }\n    MPI_Waitall((int)c.sends.size(), c.sends.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n    c.sends.clear();\n    MPI_Win_unlock_all(c.flagWin);\n    MPI_Win_unlock_all(c.dataWin);\n    MPI_Win_free(&c.flagWin);\n    MPI_Win_free(&c.dataWin);\n    MPI_Comm_free(&c.nodeComm);\n}\n\n// The local rows (c.myRows) hold A on entry and L on exit; every finished row\n// block is also available node-wide through c.blkRows.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(Ctx& c) {\n    const Dist& d = c.d;\n    const size_t nb = d.nblocks;\n    bool ok = true;\n\n    if (nb > 0 && d.owner(0) == d.rank) factorDiagonal(c, 0);\n\n    for (size_t b = 0; b < nb; ++b) {\n        waitReady(c, b);\n        if (c.status[b] >= 0.0) {\n            if (d.rank == 0)\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", (size_t)c.status[b]);\n            ok = false;\n            break;\n        }\n        size_t lb = d.localStartAfter(b);\n        if (b + 1 < nb && d.owner(b + 1) == d.rank) {\n            // Lookahead: finish the next diagonal block first so others can proceed\n            const size_t nb1 = d.blockRows(b + 1);\n            computePanel(c, b, lb, lb + nb1);\n            factorDiagonal(c, b + 1);\n            lb += nb1;\n        }\n        computePanel(c, b, lb, d.lrows);\n    }\n\n    // Complete outstanding inter-node transfers\n    while (ok && c.recvHead < c.recvs.size()) progress(c);\n    MPI_Waitall((int)c.sends.size(), c.sends.data(), MPI_STATUSES_IGNORE);\n    c.sends.clear();\n    MPI_Barrier(MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    return ok;\n}\n\n// Generate the local rows of a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(double* A, const Dist& d) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n    size_t maxRows = 0;\n    for (int q = 0; q < d.size; ++q) maxRows = std::max(maxRows, countLocalRows(n, q, d.size));\n\n    // Generate the local rows of random matrix B (same global sequence as sequential)\n    std::vector<double> Bmine(std::max<size_t>(maxRows * n, 1));\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    {\n        size_t l = 0;\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n            const bool mine = d.owner(i / NB) == d.rank;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                const double v = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n                if (mine) Bmine[l * n + k] = v;\n            }\n            if (mine) ++l;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Compute A = B * B^T, rotating blocks of B rows around a ring of ranks\n    std::vector<double> Bcur(Bmine);\n    const int right = (d.rank + 1) % d.size, left = (d.rank - 1 + d.size) % d.size;\n    for (int step = 0; step < d.size; ++step) {\n        const int src = (d.rank - step + d.size) % d.size;\n        const size_t srcRows = countLocalRows(n, src, d.size);\n        for (size_t l = 0; l < d.lrows; ++l) {\n            const double* Bi = &Bmine[l * n];\n            for (size_t lj = 0; lj < srcRows; ++lj) {\n                const size_t j = ((lj / NB) * (size_t)d.size + (size_t)src) * NB + lj % NB;\n                A[l * n + j] = dotContinue(0.0, Bi, &Bcur[lj * n], 0, n);\n            }\n        }\n        if (step + 1 < d.size) {\n            MPI_Sendrecv_replace(Bcur.data(), (int)(maxRows * n), MPI_DOUBLE, right, 0, left, 0, MPI_COMM_WORLD,\n                                 MPI_STATUS_IGNORE);\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t l = 0; l < d.lrows; ++l) {\n        A[l * n + d.globalRow(l)] += n;\n    }\n}\n\n// Assemble the full row-major factor from the node-shared blocks (rank 0's node holds all of them)\nstatic void assembleFactor(const Ctx& c, std::vector<double>& L) {\n    const size_t n = c.d.n;\n    L.assign(n * n, 0.0);\n    for (size_t b = 0; b < c.d.nblocks; ++b) {\n        const size_t j0 = b * NB, nbb = c.d.blockRows(b), j1 = j0 + nbb;\n        for (size_t r = 0; r < nbb; ++r)\n            std::memcpy(&L[(j0 + r) * n], c.blkRows[b] + r * c.blkStride[b], j1 * sizeof(double));\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const Dist& d) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    // L is the full factor (on every rank), A_orig holds the local rows\n    const size_t n = d.n;\n\n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n    // Compute L * L^T for local rows\n    for (size_t l = 0; l < d.lrows; ++l) {\n        const size_t i = d.globalRow(l);\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double sum = dotContinue(0.0, &L[i * n], &L[j * n], 0, n);\n            const double error = fabs(sum - A_orig[l * n + j]);\n            maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n            const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[l * n + j]) + 1e-10);\n            relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n        }\n    }\n    double errs[2] = {maxError, relError};\n    MPI_Allreduce(MPI_IN_PLACE, errs, 2, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_MAX, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n    maxError = errs[0];\n    relError = errs[1];\n\n    if (d.rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n        printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    }\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        if (d.rank == 0) printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    int rank = 0, size = 1;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(MPI_COMM_WORLD, &size);\n    const bool root = (rank == 0);\n\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (root) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (root) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n\n    if (root) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n        printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Distributed Cholesky decomposition (MPI, blocked, left-looking)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n//\n// Rows are distributed block-cyclically (blocks of NB rows) across ranks. Each\n// element L[i][j] is computed exactly as in the sequential algorithm:\n//     sum = 0; for k < j: sum += L[i][k] * L[j][k]; L[i][j] = (A[i][j] - sum) / L[j][j]\n// with the same summation order, so results are bit-identical to the\n// sequential version. Parallelism comes from distributing rows i and from\n// evaluating many independent (i, j) sums simultaneously with SIMD.\n\nstatic constexpr size_t NB = 32;   // panel width / row block size\nstatic constexpr size_t KC = 256;  // k-chunk length for cache blocking\nstatic constexpr size_t MR = 6;    // rows per micro-kernel\n\ntypedef double v4 __attribute__((vector_size(32)));\ntypedef double v4u __attribute__((vector_size(32), aligned(8)));\n\n// The reference (sequential) build evaluates  sum += x[k] * y[k]  for k < len as:\n//   - k < 4*floor(len/4): rounded product, then in-order addition (auto-vectorized body)\n//   - remaining k:        fused multiply-add (scalar tail)\n// The helpers below reproduce exactly this rounding so results are bit-identical.\ntemplate <typename T>\nstatic inline T noContract(T p) {\n    asm(\"\" : \"+x\"(p));  // keep the product rounded (no FMA contraction)\n    return p;\n}\n\nstatic inline double dotContinue(double sum, const double* x, const double* y, size_t kfrom, size_t len) {\n    const size_t kv = len & ~(size_t)3;\n    size_t k = kfrom;\n    for (; k < kv; ++k) sum += noContract(x[k] * y[k]);\n    for (; k < len; ++k) sum = __builtin_fma(x[k], y[k], sum);\n    return sum;\n}\n\nstruct Dist {\n    int rank = 0, size = 1;\n    size_t n = 0, nblocks = 0, lrows = 0;\n    int owner(size_t b) const { return (int)(b % (size_t)size); }\n    size_t blockRows(size_t b) const { return std::min(NB, n - b * NB); }\n    // Local row index at which the first owned block with index > b starts\n    size_t localStartAfter(size_t b) const {\n        const size_t r = (size_t)rank;\n        const size_t cnt = (b >= r) ? r < R; ++r) {\n            const double a = rows[r][k];\n            acc0[r] += noContract(a * p0);\n            acc1[r] += noContract(a * p1);\n        }\n    }\n    for (size_t r = 0; r < R; ++r) {\n        *(v4u*)(S + r * NB) = acc0[r];\n        *(v4u*)(S + r * NB + 4) = acc1[r];\n    }\n}\n\ntemplate <size_t R>\nstatic inline void microKernelTiles(double* const* rowsBase, size_t k0, const double* P, size_t j0,\n                                    size_t ntiles, size_t klen, double* S) {\n    const double* rows[R];\n    for (size_t r = 0; q < MR; ++q) rows[q] = &L[(lb + r + q) * n];\n            microKernelTiles<MR>(rows, k0, P, j0, ntiles, klen, S + r * NB);\n        }\n        for (; r < cnt; ++r) {\n            double* rows[1] = {&L[(lb + r) * n]};\n            microKernelTiles<1>(rows, k0, P, j0, ntiles, klen, S + r * NB);\n        }\n        pollRequest(poll);\n    }\n}\n\n// Build transposed panel P from rows given by rowPtr(jj), columns < j0\ntemplate <typename RowFn>\nstatic void buildPanel(double* P, size_t j0, size_t nbb, RowFn rowPtr) {\n    const size_t ntiles = (nbb + 7) / 8;\n    for (size_t t = 0;
